notes: Adds two tables to the existing schema (see db-schema.json) for the BCM creation feature.
Both tables hang off projects via project_id with ON DELETE CASCADE.
BCM data only ever exists for projects of type 'value_discovery'; this is enforced in the application layer, not via DB constraint.

tables.name: bcm_capabilities
tables.purpose: Hierarchical capability tree (L1 / L2 / L3) for a project's Business Capability Map. Adjacency list (parent_id) with explicit level for fast filtering and hierarchy validation.

columns.name: parent_id
columns.comment: NULL for L1; FK to another row in this table for L2/L3

columns.name: position
columns.comment: Order among siblings under the same parent

invariants: level=2 -> parent_id is a row with level=1 in the same project
level=3 -> parent_id is a row with level=2 in the same project
These are enforced at write time in the API layer.

tables.name: bcm_chat_messages
tables.purpose: Chat transcript between the user and the BCM creation agent, one row per logical message turn.

columns.name: raw
columns.comment: Provider-native message JSON for the assistant turn (tool_use/tool_result blocks) used to replay context on the next call. NULL on user rows.
